scripts.build: pnpm --filter @mars-explorer/shared build && pnpm --filter @mars-explorer/api build && pnpm --filter @mars-explorer/web build
scripts.check: pnpm --filter @mars-explorer/shared build && for f in $(find apps/*/src packages/*/src -name '*.check.ts'); do node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON $f || exit 1; done
scripts.smoke: pnpm check && pnpm smoke:api && pnpm smoke:voice && pnpm smoke:pages && pnpm smoke:explore && pnpm smoke:game && pnpm smoke:voice-ui && pnpm smoke:ui
scripts.refresh:missions: python3 scripts/refresh-samples.py && python3 scripts/refresh-ingenuity.py && python3 scripts/refresh-curiosity.py && python3 scripts/refresh-swim-ice.py && python3 scripts/refresh-meda.py
